title: Proportioning on the basis of field experience and/or trial mixtures.
officialText: Concrete proportioning determined on the basis of field experience or trial mixtures shall be done in accordance with ACI 318, Section 5.3 and Sections 1905.3.1 through 1905.3.5 of this chapter.
